dct_description_sm: Approximate centre point location dataset of public hospitals/hospital grounds in Myanmar as of 2020. Produced by CDE Myanmar based on publicly available reference lists and local knowledge and improving geographic coordinates using mostly large scale satellite/google satellite. Spatial dataset created based on 1:5.000 - 1:2.000 scaled imagery. Smaller facilities often only be village location or best guess hospital-like looking features near the original coordinate/settlement. Original dataset title: Public Hospitals in Myanmar as of 2020
